component_contracts.content_rules: Use one concise outcome-oriented label; never substitute an unlabeled glyph for a named action.
component_contracts.accessibility: Use native button semantics, visible focus, an accessible name, and deterministic disabled/loading feedback.

interaction_patterns.trigger: open a source-backed analytical data surface
interaction_patterns.dismissal: not applicable; navigate or close the parent surface
interaction_patterns.focus_behavior: logical row and control order with sticky headings excluded from the tab sequence
interaction_patterns.keyboard_behavior: all controls are reachable; sorting and paging expose names and state

layout_contract.grid: compact icon rail plus overlaying contextual navigation and a fluid rounded analytical workspace
layout_contract.content_width: adaptive responsive Web from 768px through 1920px with bounded analytical surfaces and local overflow
layout_contract.scroll_policy: preserve stable workspace geometry; contextual navigation overlays rather than resizes the desktop workspace; analytical tables and series panels own overflow
layering_rules: contextual navigation flyout overlays the desktop workspace and becomes a viewport-contained modal drawer when required by width
report inspector uses a sibling pane on wide Web and a viewport-contained overlay on narrow Web
high-cardinality series use a right sibling panel or lower panel without redefining chart semantics

responsive_contract.overflow_policy: use local overflow for analytical grids; do not hide primary task, trust, or recovery controls
responsive_contract.zoom_policy: preserve meaning and operation at 200% zoom within the supported Web contract
responsive_contract.localization_stress_policy: verify independent RU and EN content stress without changing identity or truncating essential meaning

accessibility_contract.focus_indicator: minimum 2px visible focus treatment with sufficient contrast
accessibility_contract.keyboard_navigation: all named controls, dialogs, drawers, menus, tables, and focus surfaces remain keyboard-operable
accessibility_contract.target_size: 32px compact analytical minimum with larger critical and touch-adjacent actions where source-backed
accessibility_contract.contrast: target WCAG 2.2 AA contrast; conformance requires later browser evidence
accessibility_contract.reduced_motion: honor prefers-reduced-motion and remove nonessential transitions
